title: Our Approach
text:
01 — The model
    Enterprise practices, lean infrastructure.
  
  The engineering standards don't change: version control, tested pipelines, defined metrics, monitoring. What changes is the footprint, and the bill.



  




Typical enterprise approach
Our approach




Platform
Licensed BI and ETL suites with per-seat pricing
Open-source and managed services; pay for what you use


Infrastructure
Dedicated servers or a cloud data platform to administer
Serverless and managed hosting, with nothing to patch


People
A data team and an IT team to keep it running
One accountable builder, plus documentation anyone can follow


Timeline
Months of requirements and procurement
Weeks, delivered in usable pieces


Ownership
Tied to vendors and contracts
Your accounts, your code, your data








  
    02 — Principles
    Four rules we build by.
  
  They sound simple. They're also the four things most often skipped when a project goes sideways.



  
    01
    Start from the decision
    Every dashboard and pipeline starts with a question someone needs answered, not with a tool someone wants to use.
  
  
    02
    Use what you already have
    We connect to your existing systems rather than asking you to replace them or change how your team works.
  
  
    03
    Trust the numbers
    Output is validated against figures you already know, so the first thing you see is something you can believe.
  
  
    04
    Leave it maintainable
    Clear code, clear docs, and no clever one-offs, so the next person to touch it (you, us, or anyone else) can pick it up.
  




  
    03 — The payoff
    What good data actually surfaces.
  
  Integrated, well-modeled data shows you things no single system can. A simple retail example: the products that sell the most are often not the ones that make the most money.




  Share of volume
  Share of gross margin

    Line A: share of volume 42%

    24%
  
  Line B
  
    Line B: share of volume 18%
    18%
    Line B: share of gross margin 22%
    22%
  
  Line C
  
    Line C: share of volume 25%
    25%
    Line C: share of gross margin 40%
    40%
  
  Other
  
    Other: share of volume 15%
    15%
    Other: share of gross margin 14%

Illustrative example, not client data. Line C earns far more than its volume suggests, while Line A's margin trails its volume. Seeing this takes sales and cost data joined in one model.


The same pattern shows up everywhere: service lines versus billable hours, marketing channels versus customer lifetime value, programs versus cost per outcome. The industry changes; the work doesn't. Connect the data, model it properly, and put the answer in front of the person who needs it.



  
    04 — Fit
    Who this is built for.
  
  If you've outgrown spreadsheets but a full-time hire or an enterprise platform feels like overkill, you're in the right place.



  
    Small & mid-sized businesses
    Teams that have outgrown spreadsheets but can't justify a full-time data or IT hire.
  
  
    Teams inside larger organizations
    Departments that need something built now and can't wait in the central IT queue.
  
  
    Startups & nonprofits
    Organizations that need solid data foundations without burning budget on enterprise tooling.
  
  
    Retail & hospitality operators
    Businesses sitting on POS and inventory data they've never been able to put to work.
  



  
    Next step
    See if it's a fit, in fifteen minutes.
    Tell us what you're working with. You'll get a straight answer on what's possible.

title: About
text:
Founder & Principal
    Dom Schenone
    I'm a Business Intelligence analyst working in renewable energy, where I build the ETL pipelines, automation, and dashboards that let a company actually see what its own data is telling it.
    I have a Bachelor's from UCLA and a Master's in Business Analytics from UCSD, and I've spent my career in Python, SQL, Power BI, and Power Query, the exact toolkit behind everything on this site.
    Inside a large organization, getting good data takes a warehouse, a stack of licensed tools, and a team to run them. Most businesses need the same outcome without any of that overhead. That's the gap this consultancy exists to close.
    I'm based in Ocean Beach, San Diego, and work directly with every client. Remote engagements are welcome.
  


The same engineering rigor I use every day, applied with lean, right-sized infrastructure and priced for businesses that have never had a data team.


  EducationUCLA, Bachelor'sUCSD, MS Business Analytics

title: Services
text:
01
    Website & web app development
    
      Marketing sites, client portals, and internal tools. Built to be fast, accessible, and easy to update, and hosted on low-cost static or serverless platforms instead of a server you have to maintain. Where it helps, the site connects directly to your data: live metrics, customer-facing reports, or lightweight admin tools.
      Static & serverless hostingClient portalsInternal tools
    
  
  
    02
    Business intelligence & dashboards
    
      Dashboards and reports designed around the decisions you actually make. KPIs are defined once and calculated consistently, and everything refreshes automatically so the numbers are current when you open them.
      Power BILooker StudioCustom front ends
    
  
  
    03
    Data integration & APIs
    
      Getting data out of the systems you run on and into one place, reliably and on schedule. Includes authentication, incremental syncs, and handling for the messy edge cases vendor APIs always have.
      POSCRME-commerceAccounting & ERPSpreadsheets
    
  
  
    04
    ETL & pipeline engineering
    
      Python and SQL pipelines that extract, validate, transform, and load your data, with tests, logging, and alerting built in. Scheduled with lightweight orchestration rather than heavyweight platforms, so there's nothing to babysit and little to pay for.
      PythonSQLGitHub ActionsCloud schedulers
    
  
  
    05
    Data modeling & warehousing
    
      A clean, documented data model, from a normalized operational schema to a dimensional model or semantic layer built for reporting. Hosted on managed, low-cost infrastructure sized to your data, not to a sales quota.
      PostgreSQLDimensional modelingSemantic layers
    
  
  
    06
    Automation & advisory
    
      Replacing recurring manual work (weekly reports, spreadsheet reconciliations, copy-paste between systems) with automation. Also available: architecture reviews, tool selection, and a second opinion before you commit to an expensive platform.
      Scheduled reportsAlertsArchitecture review
    
  



  
    Engagements
    Three ways to work together.
  
  Every engagement starts with a written scope. Pick the structure that fits the work, and change it as your needs change.



  
    Where most clients start
    Fixed-scope project
    A defined deliverable at a fixed price. Best for a new site, a dashboard suite, or a specific integration.
    
      Written scope and quote up front
      Delivered in usable milestones
      Documentation and handoff included
    
  
  
    Ongoing
    Monthly maintenance
    Keep anything we've built healthy and growing, for a flat monthly fee.
    
      Monitoring and alerting
      Fixes when APIs or rules change
      Small enhancements each month
      No long-term contract
    
  
  
    Flexible
    Hourly & advisory
    For reviews, troubleshooting, or extending something you already have.
    
      Architecture and code reviews
      Troubleshooting existing systems
      Estimate before work starts
    
  



  
  
    Support is an option, never a lock-in.
    Pipelines and dashboards need care over time: APIs change, business rules shift, new sources appear. A monthly plan keeps all of that handled. But everything we build lives in your accounts, with your code and documentation, so you can run it yourself anytime.
  



  
    Next step
    Not sure which fits? Let's scope it together.
    Describe what you're working with and you'll get an honest read on the right approach, even if that's "you don't need us."
  
  Talk about your project

    01 — Capabilities
    Everything between your raw data and the decision.
  
  Most projects touch more than one of these: an integration that feeds a warehouse that powers a dashboard embedded in a website. We build the whole path, or just the piece you're missing.



  
    01
    
    Websites & web apps
    Fast, maintainable sites and internal tools, from a clean marketing site to a custom portal that sits on top of your data.
  
  
    02
    
    Dashboards & BI
    Always-current reporting in Power BI, Looker Studio, or a custom front end, built around the questions you actually ask.
  
  
    03
    
    Data integrations
    Connect the systems you already use (POS, CRM, accounting, spreadsheets, third-party APIs) so data flows automatically instead of by copy-paste.
  
  
    04
    
    ETL pipelines
    Scheduled, tested pipelines in Python and SQL that extract, clean, and load your data so the numbers are right every morning.
  
  
    05
    
    Data modeling & warehousing
    One well-structured source of truth, whether a Postgres warehouse or a tidy semantic model, so every report agrees with every other one.
  
  
    06
    
    Automation & reporting
    Recurring reports, alerts, and manual workflows turned into things that simply run on schedule, with no babysitting required.
  


Explore services in detail


  
    
      02 — The difference
      Right-sized, not stripped-down.
    
    Large organizations solve these problems with platform licenses, dedicated infrastructure, and a team to run it all. You need the outcome, not the overhead. Same engineering standards, a fraction of the footprint, and often less per month than a single software seat.
  
  
    git diff enterprise-stack right-sized-stack
    
      @@ what you skip @@
      -per-seat platform licenses and annual contracts
      -servers and cloud platforms to administer
      -a data team and IT staff to keep it running
      -months of requirements and procurement
       
      @@ what you keep @@
      +tested, version-controlled pipelines
      +metrics defined once and trusted everywhere
      +monitoring and alerts when something breaks
      +full ownership of your code, accounts, and data
    
  



  
    03 — Process
    A clear path from problem to production.
  
  No open-ended retainers or surprise invoices. You'll know what's being built, what it costs, and when it lands before any work starts.



  
    01
    Discover
    A short conversation about what you're trying to see, fix, or automate, and a look at the systems you already have.
  
  
    02
    Scope & quote
    A written plan with a fixed price, so you know exactly what you're getting and what it costs.
  
  
    03
    Build & validate
    Iterative delivery, checked against the numbers you already trust. Nothing ships until it's right.
  
  
    04
    Hand off or maintain
    Take full ownership with documentation, or keep us on a monthly plan to monitor and extend it.
  



  
    Get started
